intent: Provide the minimal amodal contracts needed to describe, address, and manipulate a KONITIF application without depending on a specific runtime or projection.

clusters.title: Application and manifest
clusters.summary: Declares an application identity and composes its tool manifest.

clusters.title: Tools and capabilities
clusters.summary: Declares what a tool provides, consumes, and requires from its host.
clusters.authority: Contract declared by the tool author.

clusters.title: Commands
clusters.summary: Registers and invokes addressable operations within an explicit context.
clusters.authority: The registry owns addressing; each command owns its effect.

clusters.title: Workspace
clusters.summary: Maintains an identifiable working state and produces isolated snapshots.
clusters.authority: The KonitifWorkspace instance owns its current in-memory state.

KonitifWorkspaceSnapshot.summary: Serializable form of a workspace state at a given point in time.
KonitifWorkspaceSnapshot.useWhen: Transfer, save, or compare the visible workspace state.
invariants: id and name are non-empty after creation
limitations: No monotonic revision is currently exposed.

KonitifWorkspace.summary: Local authority that reads and evolves the current snapshot.
KonitifWorkspace.useWhen: A host needs to manipulate a workspace behind a stable contract.
invariants: getSnapshot does not expose the internal reference
update changes only name and metadata
limitations: The contract defines neither persistence nor concurrency.

createInMemoryWorkspace.summary: Creates a volatile workspace authority from a partial initial state.
createInMemoryWorkspace.useWhen: Tests, prototypes, or hosts whose persistence is provided elsewhere.
invariants: Empty text values receive a fallback
createdAt and updatedAt are initialized as ISO 8601 timestamps
limitations: Time depends on the system clock.
Reset creates a new identity by default.

clusters.title: Time and frames
clusters.summary: Converts continuous time, discrete frames, ranges, and frame rates.

clusters.title: Values and targets
clusters.summary: Associates numeric values with targets and bounds their admissible domain.

clusters.title: Temporal structures
clusters.summary: Composes keys, tracks, clips, sequences, and interpolations without imposing a timeline projection.
clusters.authority: Authored temporal artifacts and deterministic read operators.

clusters.title: Projected states and staged changes
clusters.summary: Preserves the distinction between desired, reported, and simulated before any commit.
workflow: Send it to a commit authority

clusters.title: Artifact derivation
clusters.summary: Describes a prepared transformation between an identified source and a target artifact.
clusters.authority: Authored derivation draft, distinct from its commit and effect.

clusters.title: Package metadata
clusters.summary: Exposes the Core contract version used by the consumer.
workflow: Compare it with the expected contract
